build_hf_byte_bpe_encoder: build a HuggingFaceByteLevelBPE encoder using a vocab.json and merges.txt config file
encode_text_with_byte_bpe: encode a string into space-separated BPE token IDs using the HuggingFaceByteLevelBPE encode method
decode_byte_bpe_tokens: decode a space-separated string of BPE token IDs back to text using the decode method
check_beginning_of_word: check if a BPE token is the beginning of a word using the is_beginning_of_word method
configure_hf_byte_bpe: configure a HuggingFaceByteLevelBPEConfig dataclass with paths to bpe_vocab, bpe_merges, and add_prefix_space options
